35698-letters-of-john-keats-to-his-famil.title: Letters Of John Keats To His Family And Friends
35698-letters-of-john-keats-to-his-famil.creator: Unknown
35698-letters-of-john-keats-to-his-famil.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The object of the present volume is to supply the want, which many readers must have felt, of a separate and convenient edition of the letters of Keats to his family and friends. He is one of those poets whose genius makes itself felt in prose-writing almost as decisively as in verse, and at their best these letters are among the most beautiful in our language.

35909-indian-legends-retold.title: Legends Retold
35909-indian-legends-retold.creator: Elaine Goodale Eastman
35909-indian-legends-retold.description: A book by Elaine Goodale Eastman. One who reads these stories carefully and thoughtfully will understand something of Indian psychology. Mystery to the Indian is not mystery after all, but a reflection of the Great Mystery which opens out as simply as a flower. To us nothing is strange or impossible. It seems natural that an animal or even a rock should speak; God is in it and speaks through it.

arxiv-2012-02261.title: Global W 1 , p W^{1,p} regularity for elliptic problem with measure source and Leray-Hardy potential California State University, Los Angeles, 5151, USA. E-mail: hichem.hajaiej@gmail.com
arxiv-2012-02261.creator: Huyuan Chen
arxiv-2012-02261.description: Abstract In this paper, we develop the Littman-Stampacchia-Weinberger duality approach to obtain global W 1 , p W^{1,p} estimates for a class of elliptic problems involving Leray-Hardy operators and measure sources in a distributional framework associated to a dual formulation with a specific weight function. Key Words : Leray-Hardy potential; Duality approach; Radon measure. MSC2010 : 35J75, 35B99, 35D99.

arxiv-2102-01653.title: A late times approximation for the SYK spectral form factor
arxiv-2102-01653.creator: Matteo A. Cardella
arxiv-2102-01653.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Matteo A. Cardella. We find a late times approximation for the SYK spectral form factor from a large N N steepest descent version of the path integral over two replica collective fields. Main ingredients are a suitable uv regularization of the two replica kinetic operator, the property of its Fourier transform and some spectral analysis of the four point function two replica ladder kernel.

arxiv-2103-01753.title: Accuracy of the recovered flux of extended sources obscured by bad pixels in the central EPIC FOV
arxiv-2103-01753.creator: XMM-SOC-CAL-TN-0227
arxiv-2103-01753.description:
A 2021 arXiv research paper by XMM-SOC-CAL-TN-0227. 1
Introduction

A fraction of the XMM-Newton EPIC FOV is obscured by the dysfunctional (i.e. bad) pixels, dominated by the CCD gaps, which complicates the analysis of extended X-ray sources. Before SAS version 17.0.0 the only standard option for attempting the recovery of the obscured flux was to scale the measured flux by the fraction of the obscured detector area. This is accurate only in the very limiting case of an extended source with a uniform spatial flux distribution.

arxiv-2107-02583.title: Point Cloud Registration using Representative Overlapping Points
arxiv-2107-02583.creator: Lifa Zhu, Dongrui Liu, Changwei Lin, Rui Yan, Francisco Gómez-Fernández, Ninghua Yang, Ziyong Feng
arxiv-2107-02583.description: Abstract 3D point cloud registration is a fundamental task in robotics and computer vision. Recently, many learning-based point cloud registration methods based on correspondences have emerged. However, these methods heavily rely on such correspondences and meet great challenges with partial overlap.

arxiv-2110-14513.title: Neural Analysis and Synthesis: Reconstructing Speech from Self-Supervised Representations
arxiv-2110-14513.creator: Hyeong-Seok Choi, Juheon Lee, Wansoo Kim, Jie Hwan Lee, Hoon Heo, Kyogu Lee
arxiv-2110-14513.description: Abstract We present a neural analysis and synthesis (NANSY) framework that can manipulate voice, pitch, and speed of an arbitrary speech signal. Most of the previous works have focused on using information bottleneck to disentangle analysis features for controllable synthesis, which usually results in poor reconstruction quality.

arxiv-2206-05979.title: Top Two Algorithms Revisited
arxiv-2206-05979.creator: Marc Jourdan marc.jourdan@inria.fr, Rémy Degenne remy.degenne@inria.fr, Dorian Baudry dorian.baudry@inria.fr, Rianne de Heide r.de.heide@vu.nl, Emilie Kaufmann emilie.kaufmann@univ-lille.fr
arxiv-2206-05979.description: Abstract Top Two algorithms arose as an adaptation of Thompson sampling to best arm identification in multi-armed bandit models [ 38 ] , for parametric families of arms. They select the next arm to sample from by randomizing among two candidate arms, a leader and a challenger .

arxiv-2207-08601.title: Geometry-Aware Reference Synthesis for Multi-View Image Super-Resolution Conference: Proceedings of the 30th ACM International Conference on Multimedia ; October 10–14, 2022; Lisboa, Portugal. Proceedings of the 30th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM ’22), October 10–14, 2022, Lisboa, P
arxiv-2207-08601.creator: Ri Cheng, Yuqi Sun, Bo Yan, Weimin Tan, Chenxi Ma
arxiv-2207-08601.description: Abstract . Recent multi-view multimedia applications struggle between high-resolution (HR) visual experience and storage or bandwidth constraints. Therefore, this paper proposes a Multi-View Image Super-Resolution (MVISR) task. It aims to increase the resolution of multi-view images captured from the same scene.

arxiv-2210-14837.title: NeuralSearchX: Serving a Multi-billion-parameter Reranker for Multilingual Metasearch at a Low Cost
arxiv-2210-14837.creator: Thales Sales Almeida*, Thiago Laitz*, João Seródio*, Luiz Henrique Bonifacio, Roberto Lotufo, Rodrigo Nogueira
arxiv-2210-14837.description: Abstract The widespread availability of search API’s (both free and commercial) brings the promise of increased coverage and quality of search results for metasearch engines, while decreasing the maintenance costs of the crawling and indexing infrastructures. However, merging strategies frequently comprise complex pipelines that require careful tuning, which is often overlooked in the literature.

arxiv-2402-11653.title: Combinatorial Client-Master Multiagent Deep Reinforcement Learning for Task Offloading in Mobile Edge Computing Conference: This is a supplementary material for the extended abstract in ( Gebrekidan et al. 2024a ) ; DOI: ; 262
arxiv-2402-11653.creator: Tesfay Zemuy Gebrekidan, Sebastian Stein, Timothy J.Norman
arxiv-2402-11653.description: Abstract . Recently, there has been an explosion of mobile applications that perform computationally intensive tasks such as video streaming, data mining, virtual reality, augmented reality, image processing, video processing, face recognition, and online gaming. However, user devices (UDs), such as tablets and smartphones, have a limited ability to perform the computation needs of the tasks.

arxiv-2409-20557.title: Propose, Assess, Search: Harnessing LLMs for Goal-Oriented Planning in Instructional Videos
arxiv-2409-20557.creator: Md Mohaiminul Islam 1,2 Tushar Nagarajan 1 Huiyu Wang 1, Fu-Jen Chu 1 Kris Kitani 1 Gedas Bertasius 2 Xitong Yang 1
arxiv-2409-20557.description: Abstract Goal-oriented planning, or anticipating a series of actions that transition an agent from its current state to a predefined objective, is crucial for developing intelligent assistants aiding users in daily procedural tasks. The problem presents significant challenges due to the need for comprehensive knowledge of temporal and hierarchical task structures, as well as strong capabilities in reasoning and planning.

arxiv-2501-07968.title: Inhomogeneous model with a space dependent Cosmological Constant
arxiv-2501-07968.creator: D. Comelli
arxiv-2501-07968.description: Abstract We analyse an inhomogeneous cosmological model featuring a spherically symmetric bubble solution induced by a unified single perfect fluid, comprising spatially dependent Dark Energy (with w = − 1 w=-1 ) and Dark Matter (with w = 0 w=0 ) components. We impose an Hubble profile that matches the Planck value at early times ( H 0 = 67.

arxiv-2505-17749.title: Mind the GAP! The Challenges of Scale in Pixel-based Deep Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2505-17749.creator: Ghada Sokar, Pablo Samuel Castro
arxiv-2505-17749.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ghada Sokar, Pablo Samuel Castro. Scaling deep reinforcement learning in pixel-based environments presents a significant challenge, often resulting in diminished performance. While recent works have proposed algorithmic and architectural approaches to address this, the underlying cause of the performance drop remains unclear.

arxiv-2507-13336.title: SGCL: Unifying Self-Supervised and Supervised Learning for Graph Recommendation Conference: Proceedings of the Nineteenth ACM Conference on Recommender Systems; September 22–26, 2025; Prague, Czech Republic Proceedings of the Nineteenth ACM Conference on Recommender Systems (RecSys ’25), September 2
arxiv-2507-13336.creator: Weizhi Zhang 1 , Liangwei Yang 2† , Zihe Song 1 , Henrry Peng Zou 1 , Ke Xu 1 , Yuanjie Zhu 1 , Philip S. Yu 1
arxiv-2507-13336.description: Abstract . Recommender systems (RecSys) are essential for online platforms, providing personalized suggestions to users within a vast sea of information. Self-supervised graph learning seeks to harness high-order collaborative filtering signals through unsupervised augmentation on the user-item bipartite graph, primarily leveraging a multi-task learning framework that includes both supervised recommendation loss and self-supervised contrastive loss.

arxiv-2509-12153.title: You Are Not Alone: Designing Body Doubling for ADHD in Virtual Reality DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX
arxiv-2509-12153.creator: Zinat Ara, Imtiaz Bin Rahim, Puqi Zhou, Liuchuan Yu, Behzad Esmaeili, Lap-Fai Yu, Sungsoo Ray Hong
arxiv-2509-12153.description: Abstract . Adults with Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) experience challenges sustaining attention in the workplace. Body doubling, the concept of working alongside another person, has been proposed as a productivity aid for ADHD and other neurodivergent populations (NDs). However, prior work found no conclusive effectiveness and noted NDs’ discomfort with social presence.

arxiv-2601-05653.title: EvoQRE: Modeling Bounded Rationality in Safety-Critical Traffic Simulation via Evolutionary Quantal Response Equilibrium PubID: pubid: 0000–0000/00$00.00 © 2026 IEEE
arxiv-2601-05653.creator: Phu-Hoa Pham, Chi-Nguyen Tran, Duy-Minh Dao-Sy, Phu-Quy Nguyen-Lam, Trung-Kiet Huynh
arxiv-2601-05653.description: Abstract Existing traffic simulation frameworks for Autonomous Vehicles (AVs) typically rely on imitation learning or game-theoretic approaches solving for Nash or Coarse Correlated Equilibria (CCE). While CCE allows for correlated strategies, it assumes agents are perfectly rational utility maximizers—an assumption violated by human drivers who exhibit bounded rationality and stochastic behaviors.

arxiv-2601-12983.title: ChartAttack: Testing the Vulnerability of LLMs to Malicious Prompting in Chart Generation
arxiv-2601-12983.creator: Jesus-German Ortiz-Barajas, Jonathan Tonglet, Vivek Gupta, Iryna Gurevych
arxiv-2601-12983.description: Abstract Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used to automate chart generation from data tables, enabling efficient data analysis and reporting but also introducing new misuse risks. In this work, we introduce ChartAttack, a novel framework for evaluating how MLLMs can be misused to generate misleading charts at scale.

pmc-11409372.title: Lean Six Sigma quality improvement approach to implement clinical practice guidelines for prescribing opiates for chronic pain in a primary care setting
pmc-11409372.creator: Smita Bakhai, Jawdat Mustafa, Meghan Cloutier, Farhana Islam, Gregory D Gudleski, Jessica L Reynolds
pmc-11409372.description: BackgroundImplementing guidelines for chronic opioid management during a clinic merger posed significant challenges. Our aim was to increase the percentage of chronic pain evaluations and urine toxicology tests in patients on chronic opioid therapy from the baseline rate of less than 20% to 50% within 1 year at an academic, primary care clinic.

pmc-11433665.title: Primary Total Knee Arthroplasty for Treating Osteoarthritic Knees with Neglected Patellar Dislocation
pmc-11433665.creator: Sung Eun Kim, Seong Hwan Kim, Jung-In Lee, Hyuk-Soo Han, Myung Chul Lee, Du Hyun Ro, Vassilios S Nikolaou
pmc-11433665.description: Background and Objectives: Neglected patellar dislocation in the presence of end-stage osteoarthritis (OA) is a rare condition characterized by the patella remaining laterally dislocated without reduction. Due to the scarcity of reported cases, the optimal management approach is still uncertain. However, primary total knee arthroplasty (TKA) can serve as an effective treatment option.

pmc-11476950.title: Transjugular Intrahepatic Portosystemic Shunt (TIPS) for Treatment of Bleeding from Cardiofundal and Ectopic Varices in Cirrhosis
pmc-11476950.creator: Sarah Shalaby, Oana Nicoară-Farcău, Valeria Perez-Campuzano, Pol Olivas, Sonia Torres, Juan Carlos García-Pagán, Virginia Hernández-Gea
pmc-11476950.description: Acute variceal bleeding in cirrhosis represents a critical clinical event that significantly impacts patient prognosis, with mortality rates increasing further after a second episode. This underscores the need for immediate intervention and optimal prophylaxis. The creation of a transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt (TIPS) has been proven to be highly effective for managing esophageal variceal bleeding.

pmc-11493058.title: Photocatalysis of Adsorbed Catechol on Degussa P25 TiO2 at the Air–Solid Interface
pmc-11493058.creator: Md Ariful Hoque, Josiel Barrios Cossio, Marcelo I. Guzman
pmc-11493058.description: Semiconductor photocatalysis with commercial TiO2 (Degussa P25) has shown significant potential in water treatment of organic pollutants. However, the photoinduced reactions of adsorbed catechol, a phenolic air pollutant from biomass burning and combustion emissions, at the air–solid interface of TiO2 remain unexplored.

pmc-11673814.title: Native and Non-Native Speakers’ Recognition of Chinese Two-Character Words in Audio Sentence Comprehension
pmc-11673814.creator: Wenling Ma, Degao Li, Xiuling Dong, Neil Dagnall
pmc-11673814.description: Two experiments were conducted to examine native and non-native speakers’ recognition of Chinese two-character words (2C-words) in the context of audio sentence comprehension. The recording was played of a sentence, in which a collocation composed of a number word, a sortal classifier, and a noun (NCN) was embedded.

pmc-12535393.title: Bullvalene‐Containing Molecular Glasses
pmc-12535393.creator: Yuzhen Wen, Christopher Hogg, Mariia Kuznetsova, Aisha N Bismillah, Stephen J Cowling, Paul R McGonigal
pmc-12535393.description: Organic molecular glasses are attractive matrices to disperse active ingredients in pharmaceuticals or electronic devices. Typically, they i) have lower glass transition temperatures than inorganic or polymeric glasses, making them easier to process, and ii) are less prone to phase segregation from other organic active materials.

pmc-12651325.title: Effects of Exercise on Cognitive Function in People with Intellectual Disabilities: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials

pmc-13623840.title: Integrated analyses of metagenomics, metabolomics and culture-based assays reveal functional roles of gut microbiota in Felidae
pmc-13623840.creator: Dini Hu, Chenghang Sun, Tong Xin, Yixin Liu, Tianchun Pu, Shunfu He, Yanqiang Yin, Yibo Hu
pmc-13623840.description: The functional roles of gut microbiota in carnivores remain poorly understood. Here, we integrated metagenomics, metabolomics, proteomics and culture-based functional assays to characterize metabolic potential of gut microbiota across 14 captive Felidae species. Comparative metagenomics analysis revealed that the Felidae gut microbiome is distinct from that of non-Felidae and reflects carnivorous dietary patterns.

pmc-13678853.title: A Lip Mass Revealing Syphilis: A Case Report With a Review of the Literature
pmc-13678853.creator: May Ahmed Alsenani, Rana Saud Alshagroud, Emad Hadlaq, Bader Mutrik Aldawsari, Hassan Ibrahim Khormi, Abdulrahman A. Altariqi, Norah Ameen Aloushan, Abdulaziz khalid Aloshaywi, Mohammed Abdulaziz Alangari
pmc-13678853.description: BackgroundSyphilis is a chronic systemic infection caused by Treponema pallidum and is well known for its wide spectrum of clinical presentations. Oral manifestations are uncommon and often mimic benign or reactive lesions, making diagnosis challenging, particularly in the absence of overt systemic symptoms.
